Install Letter Maker

Add this app to your home screen to open it in one tap, like a normal app.

Letter templates

Tap a template to load it, then edit the details. Use 🌐 To Hindi to convert it.

Drafts (this device)

Kaam ke beech mein save kiya hua letter yahan milega — sirf isi phone/browser par. Official letter jo teeno se sign hona hai, uske liye "Awaiting signatures" dekhein.

Signature & stamp

Upload once — then insert into any letter with the ✍ and ◎ buttons. Tip: a photo on white paper works well.

Verify document

Kisi letter ki authenticity check karne ke liye, us par print hua Document ID aur Code (seal ke paas) yahan daalein.

Awaiting signatures

Change password

Apni marzi se naya password set kar sakte hain. Agli baar login isi naye password se hoga.

Reject this letter

Yeh letter approval se hat kar wapas editable ban jayega. Reason likhna zaroori nahi, par likhna behtar hai taaki drafter ko pata chale kya theek karna hai.

Signed & approved

Yeh sab letters teeno se approve ho chuke hain — record ke liye yahan save hain.

Backup & restore

Your register, signature, stamp and settings are stored inside this phone's browser. If browser data is cleared or the phone changes, it is lost — so keep a backup file safely (e.g. on Google Drive or WhatsApp to yourself).

A backup file contains: saved letters register, signature & stamp images, signatory names and current draft.

Send on WhatsApp

Each resident gets the letter text personalised with their name and flat. Tap Send one by one — WhatsApp opens with the message ready; you just press send.
